dcterms:description: SIMMC 2.0 is a dataset designed for task-oriented dialog systems, featuring multi-modal conversations in a virtual reality shopping context. It includes 11,244 dialogs with various multi-modal subtasks such as disambiguation, coreference resolution, dialog state tracking, and response generation.
dcterms:title: SIMMC 2.0
